[P2] Preserve deadline processing for detached runners

Deleting the participant also removes its waits/retries from deadline selection and `onClockAdvanced()` notifications. A caller can create a callback outside a parallel, race an invoke against a short wait with `minSuccessful: 1`, then await that callback. If the invoked function sends the callback after a one-hour durable wait, its deadline now receives no processing until its real timer fires, causing the caller's test to time out despite `skipTime: true`. Abandoning the invoke result does not eliminate dependencies on the invoked function's side effects. Separate clock-blocking participation from deadline processing, and add an integration regression where an abandoned child resumes and delivers a callback.
